history.text: Welcome to Orlen's Wares, traveler. Have a look at my goods.

My supply wagon out of Greywatch is three days late. Twenty years I've run this shop and it's never been more than a day behind. Something's wrong on that road. I'd take it as a real kindness — and pay you fairly — if you'd ride east and find out what's become of it.
